# Knowledge Cache

Date-tagged, reusable facts learned from web research in this project. Persistent across sessions; read this index first before calling `tavily_*`, `firecrawl_*`, or `context7_*` to avoid re-fetching the same answer.

## Convention

- **Path:** `.agents/docs/cache/<topic>/YYYY-MM-DD-<short-slug>.md` — one topic per file, ISO date prefix sorts chronologically.
- **Index:** this file lists every entry with relative link, topic, source URL, capture date, and a freshness note.
- **Scope:** only persistent, reusable, volatile facts belong here. One-off answers, scratchpads, and transient work go in `.tmp/`.
- **Re-verify:** CLI tool / framework APIs are volatile — re-verify if the entry is more than 6 months old, or if the domain has had a major release.

### kilo-webtools-benchmark

- [2026-08-17 — `websearch` vs `tavily_*` / `firecrawl_*` / `context7_*` benchmark](kilo-webtools-benchmark/2026-08-17-kilo-webtools-benchmark.md) — 9 queries × all available tools in one session; `websearch` matched or beat `tavily_search` on query-specificity in 6/9; `context7` won on React, lost on gpg-agent (library not in index); `tavily_research` gave the best synthesis on vector DBs and PQC OpenPGP. Promoted `websearch` to Tier 1.5 in `dot_config/kilo/exact_rules/web-tools-priority.md`. **Round 3 (same file, 2026-08-17) added: regression test of previously-auth-gated firecrawl tools (`firecrawl_research_search_papers`, `firecrawl_research_inspect_paper`, `firecrawl_research_read_paper`, `firecrawl_research_related_papers`, `firecrawl_research_search_github`, `firecrawl_developer_search`) — now working after `kilo mcp auth firecrawl`. Found `firecrawl_research_related_papers` empty pool on fresh 2026 seeds (citation graph immaturity); `firecrawl_developer_search` weaker than `websearch` for raw commit-hash queries. Rule updated to add 5 new Tier 3 rows and refresh the auth-required-tools note.** Sources: live tool-call output, Kilo docs page (`kilo.ai/docs/automate/tools`), RFC 9980, postquantum.com, iotdigitaltwinplm.com, NXP SE050 datasheet, OpenWrt forum/wiki, Aumasson's Substack, arXiv 2605.07363 (MISA), 1706.03762 (Attention is All You Need), DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp GitHub repo, Linux kernel commits 6db21d8 and f176a7c3.

### kilo-subagents

Verified against the local Kilo/opencode source tree (`~/Playground/git/kilocode/packages/opencode/src/...`) and the official kilo.ai docs. Re-verify against `packages/opencode/src/agent/agent.ts` and `packages/opencode/src/provider/transform.ts` every 3-6 months — the variant tables and native agent set shift frequently.

- [2026-08-15 — agent frontmatter reference](kilo-subagents/2026-08-15-agent-frontmatter-reference.md) — full field table for `.kilo/agent/*.md` frontmatter (description, mode, model, variant, prompt, permission, temperature, top_p, hidden, steps, color, displayName, source, options, requirements, disable), path and naming rules, body-as-prompt semantics, the `null` delete-sentinel pattern, deprecated `tools:`/`maxSteps:` mappings. Sources: `packages/core/src/v1/config/agent.ts`, `packages/opencode/src/config/agent.ts`, kilo.ai docs.
- [2026-08-15 — built-in agents](kilo-subagents/2026-08-15-built-in-agents.md) — all eight visible native agents (`code`, `plan`, `debug`, `ask`, `orchestrator`, `general`, `explore`, `scout`) plus three locked utilities (`compaction`, `title`, `summary`); per-agent permission maps, the Kilo-specific bash allowlist, plan-mode hardening, sticky-model behaviour. Sources: `packages/opencode/src/agent/agent.ts`, `packages/opencode/src/kilocode/agent/index.ts`.
- [2026-08-15 — permissions: actions, patterns, precedence](kilo-subagents/2026-08-15-permissions-actions-precedence.md) — `allow`/`ask`/`deny`/`null` semantics; `findLast` last-match-wins rule; known permission keys (incl. Kilo-specific `interactive_terminal`, `repo_clone`, `kilo_memory_*`); `**` is **not** recursive (it's the same as `*`); sensitive-file guard for `.env`/`.env.*`; bash parsing splits chains before matching; scalar-only permission keys are coerced on round-trip. Sources: `packages/opencode/src/permission/index.ts`, `packages/core/src/v1/config/permission.ts`.
- [2026-08-15 — subagent model and variant resolution](kilo-subagents/2026-08-15-subagent-model-resolution.md) — four-step chain (sticky pick → agent frontmatter → `subagent_model` → parent model); `subagent_variant_overrides` keyed by `provider/model`; the `variant:` frontmatter field only applies when the agent's own `model:` is active; sticky pick lives at `~/.local/state/kilo/model.json` (CLI only). Sources: `packages/opencode/src/kilocode/tool/task.ts:138-199`, `packages/opencode/src/provider/transform.ts`.
- [2026-08-15 — reasoning variants per provider](kilo-subagents/2026-08-15-reasoning-variants-by-provider.md) — full per-provider effort tables (Anthropic adaptive vs budget, OpenAI gated by `release_date` for `none`/`xhigh`, Google thinkingBudget vs thinkingLevel, Bedrock `reasoningConfig`, Mistral single-effort, OpenRouter/Kilo Gateway `reasoning.effort` envelope, Cerebras/TogetherAI/xAI/DeepInfra/Venice/OpenAI-compatible, Copilot); wire field name per provider; OpenAI `none` released 2025-11-13 and `xhigh` on 2025-12-04 (Responses API). Sources: `packages/opencode/src/provider/transform.ts:528-1099`, OpenAI docs, kilo.ai gateway docs.
- [2026-08-15 — subagent delegation and parent inheritance](kilo-subagents/2026-08-15-subagent-delegation-inheritance.md) — Kilo intentionally diverges from upstream opencode (anomalyco/opencode#31696): parent's `deny` on `edit`/`bash`/`notebook_*` AND on MCP-prefixed permissions **survives** into subagent sessions; parent's `ask`/`allow` **does not replace** the subagent's policy. Plus one-level-delegation ceiling (`nestedTask: true`) and three hard denies appended to every subagent (`task`, `question`, `interactive_terminal`). Sources: `packages/opencode/src/kilocode/tool/task.ts:34-86`.
- [2026-08-15 — agent config precedence](kilo-subagents/2026-08-15-agent-config-precedence.md) — discovery paths (`{agent,agents}/**/*.md` in `.kilo/`, `~/.kilo/`, `~/.config/kilo/`); merge order (built-in → global JSON → project JSON → global `.md` → project `.md` → env overrides); per-field override semantics (concatenation for `permission`, deep-merge for `options`, replace with `null` delete sentinel for the rest); naming rules (filename = name, nested dirs = namespaced, `build`→`code`, `architect`→`plan`); markdown source trust model (untrusted external, `{env:...}` blocked, `{file:...}` confined to project). Sources: `packages/opencode/src/config/agent.ts`, `packages/opencode/src/agent/agent.ts`, kilo.ai docs.
- [2026-08-15 — best practices and anti-patterns](kilo-subagents/2026-08-15-best-practices.md) — synthesised rules for designing subagents, primaries, permissions, and model selection; anti-patterns (`*: allow`, reversed catch-all order, mismatched MCP sanitization, missing `disable: true` after rename); verification commands. Builds on the six entries above.
- [2026-08-17 — revalidation at v7.4.22](kilo-subagents/2026-08-17-revalidation-v7.4.22.md) — corrections against tag `v7.4.22` (`67cda85`): `resolveModel` gained a workflow step; `KiloTask.inherited` dropped bash-deny carryover (#11523); `KiloTask.permissions` adds `suggest` deny (4 total); **no `top_k` frontmatter field** (only `temperature` + `top_p`; `top_k` via `options:` or transform default only). Authoritative correction record for the three entries above.
- [2026-08-17 — revalidation deep pass at v7.4.22](kilo-subagents/2026-08-17-revalidation-v7.4.22-deep.md) — second-pass audit: confirms the substantive findings above, fixes a line-number drift in the `KiloTask.permissions` cite (`task.ts:97-106` → `86-94`), adds verification of `title`/`temperature: 0.5`, `Flag.KILO_CLIENT === "cli"` sticky-pick gate, `subagent_depth` default, and OpenAI rollout dates; notes that the **bodies** of the original 2026-08-15 entries still assert stale claims (4-step chain, bash inheritance, 3 hard denies) — the revalidation entries are the authoritative correction record.
- [2026-08-17 — creative vs. conservative subagent sampling parameters per OpenRouter model](kilo-subagents/2026-08-17-creative-conservative-sampling-by-openrouter-model.md) — per-model `supported_parameters` matrix for the 5 candidates (`minimax-m3`, `deepseek-v4-flash-0731`, `qwen3.7-flash`, `gpt-5.6-luna`, `inkling-small`); **gpt-5.6-luna rejects temperature/top_p/top_k on OpenRouter** (drop from the creative/conservative pair); `qwen3.7-flash` rejects `top_k`; `deepseek-v4-flash-0731` ignores sampling when thinking is on; only `inkling-small` accepts the full contrast. Concrete pair recipes (Inkling-small for full flexibility; DeepSeek V4 Flash with thinking off for cheapest). Sources: OpenRouter model pages, typingmind catalog mirror, upstream model cards, kilocode source — re-verify weekly on OpenRouter catalog.
